overview.summary: The Distributor module represents the mid-chain bulk-logistics tier of the EPTTS mobile app's serialized pharmaceutical supply chain (Manufacturer -> Distributor -> Branch/Pharmacy -> Patient). A Distributor account (e.g. testdistributor2@eptts.com / Admin@123456) receives bulk shipments from manufacturers and dispatches onward shipments to pharmacies and branches, and participates in the returns chain both as an initiator (Manufacturer Return, sending packs back up to the manufacturer) and as a receiver of downstream returns (Incoming Returns from pharmacies/branches). Every action is submitted as an EPCIS event to the national EPTTS registry ('Masar'), viewable in the Distributor's own EPCIS History log. The Distributor Home screen exposes 5 tiles — one fewer category than Branch's 7, because no Delete Account or Logout tile is surfaced on the Distributor home grid in the captured build (logout is presumed accessible via a different mechanism, not yet located).
overview.rolesInvolved: Distributor staff user — logs in via Keycloak Sign In with a distributor account (e.g. testdistributor2@eptts.com / Admin@123456). No sub-roles are documented; all distributor users see the same 5-tile home screen and have access to all distributor operations (create/receive shipments, all 3 return sub-flows, EPCIS history). Access tokens expire every 15 minutes with no auto-refresh — the app shows an 'Unauthorized' state with a non-functional Retry button, requiring the user to logout and log back in manually.
overview.mainWorkflows:
1) Distributor Home: Login with distributor credentials -> Home screen shows 5 tiles: Create Shipment (new outbound shipment to a pharmacy or branch), My Shipments (view outbound shipments + statuses), Receive Shipment (accept incoming shipments from manufacturers), Returns (sub-menu, 3 options), EPCIS History (full event log). No explicit Logout tile observed in the initial screenshot; logout mechanism location is unconfirmed for this role.

2) Create Shipment: Distributor Home -> Create Shipment -> form with Destination GLN field (search input, 'Search by name or GLN', autocomplete) and ERP Invoice Number field (free text, 'Enter invoice number') -> tap Destination GLN field, type a pharmacy name or GLN number, select from autocomplete suggestions -> enter the ERP Invoice Number from the distributor's ERP system -> tap Create Draft -> draft shipment created -> screen transitions to the pack-scanning screen -> scan each pack barcode to add serialised packs to the shipment -> when packing complete, submit/dispatch the shipment. After creation the shipment appears in My Shipments with 'Draft' status.

3) My Shipments: Distributor Home -> My Shipments -> Shipments list (sorted newest first) with cards showing invoice/shipment name, sender (up arrowhead), receiver (down arrowhead), items x packs, date, and status badge (Draft=orange, Dispatched=blue/grey, Delivered=green); a 'Filter by status' dropdown narrows results. Tap a shipment -> Shipment Detail: invoice summary (invoice number, From/To parties, Items, Packs), pack list with per-pack statuses, status badge, and context-dependent actions (e.g. dispatch button while Draft; no actions once Delivered). Shipment names in test data follow free-text ERP invoice formats (e.g. 'test-963147', 'test-96324').

4) Receive Shipment: Distributor Home -> Receive Shipment -> Screen 1 'Incoming Invoices' list: cards show invoice number, sender name (down arrow, e.g. Janssen), pack count (tappable link), date, and status badge (Dispatched=blue, Partially Delivered=teal/green) -> tap an invoice -> Screen 2 'Receive Shipment' scan screen: invoice summary card (Invoice #, From, To, Items count, Packs count), Scan Progress card (progress bar + 'X / Y' counter + percentage), circular Scan Barcode button (opens camera scanner), Scanned tab (successfully scanned packs) and Remaining tab (packs not yet scanned, shows 'No items scanned yet' empty state initially) -> scan each pack barcode on the physical delivery -> each successful scan increments the progress counter and moves the pack from Remaining to Scanned -> once 100% complete, submit to confirm receipt; this progresses the shipment from Dispatched to Delivered (or Partially Delivered if incomplete). Invoice formats observed: 'Invtest182', 'INV2837', 'DESADV-RFtest-006', 'DESADV-REFtest-001'. The 'To' party for distributor-received shipments is 'New Branch' or the distributor's own entity.

5) Returns (sub-menu, 3 tiles): Manufacturer Return (blue) -> scan area 'Tap to scan pack / SSCC' (camera input) + optional 'Note (optional)' text field (reason for return) -> tap scan area, scan the pack barcode or SSCC (container code) -> optionally enter a note -> tap 'Initiate Return' to submit -> success confirmation shown; return appears in My Returns. My Returns (green) -> Filter button (filter returns by status) + return cards showing Return # (e.g. RET-2026-000019), From GLN (up arrow), To GLN (down arrow), Items count, Created date, Status badge (CONFIRMED=green, CANCELLED=red/pink) -> tap a return card to see detail. Incoming Returns (yellow/tan) -> Filter button + return cards (Return #, From GLN, To GLN, Items, Created date, Status badge: PENDING=yellow/orange, CANCELLED=red/pink) -> list of returns sent to this distributor by downstream parties (pharmacies/branches); PENDING returns are awaiting action; tap a return to review and accept/reject it.

6) EPCIS History: Distributor Home -> EPCIS History -> Status dropdown (default 'All statuses') -> event list (ordered by event time, newest first) with cards showing UUID event hash (e.g. '9836703d37524caea8e115caf675c0c0'), event type (RECEIVING/SHIPPING/UNPACKING), Sender name, Receiver name, Items count, Event Time, and Status badge (Completed=green, Failed=red/orange). Failed entries show an 'N of N events failed' summary and a 'View event errors' link. Tap a Failed card -> error detail bottom sheet (NOT a new page) showing Sequence#, event type, error code, error message; tap x to dismiss. Receiver names in test data include Arabic pharmacy names (e.g. 'صيدلية د. هشام ابراهيم'), confirming multi-language support. Observed test parties: 'New Branch', 'Janssen', 'provision hospitals cairo tender'.
overview.businessRules: Shipment statuses: Draft (editable — packs can be added/removed, or dispatched), Dispatched (read-only until confirmed as delivered by recipient), Delivered (fully read-only), Partially Delivered (a partial-scan outcome at receive time). Return statuses: PENDING (awaiting action, must be dealt with before it expires), CONFIRMED (green, terminal), CANCELLED (red/pink, terminal, cannot be reactivated). Return numbering: RET-YYYY-NNNNNN (sequential) or AGENT-RTB-<UUID> (agent-generated). EPCIS event statuses: Completed (green) vs Failed (red/orange) with structured error code + message surfaced only in a bottom sheet. Create Shipment validation: Destination GLN required (cannot create draft without a valid GLN selected; no-results state on empty search), ERP Invoice Number required (cannot be empty); duplicate invoice numbers should trigger a system warning; network errors show a graceful error with retry. Receive Shipment validation: scanning a barcode not in the invoice manifest produces 'Pack not in this shipment' error; scanning a duplicate produces an 'Already scanned' warning; partial receipt (submitting before 100%) results in 'Partially Delivered' status; network errors show a graceful error + retry. Returns validation: Manufacturer Return requires a scan (note is optional); invalid barcode shows an error message; CANCELLED returns cannot be reactivated; PENDING incoming returns require action before they expire. GLN values observed in test data: 6224010009998, 5413868000009, 6224010004313. Session/token rule (platform-wide, applies to Distributor): access tokens expire every 15 minutes with no auto-refresh; expired-session UI shows 'Unauthorized' plus a non-functional Retry button, forcing manual logout/login.

overview.openQuestions: No explicit Logout tile was observed on Distributor Home in the captured screenshot (unlike Branch/Inspector) — the workflow doc explicitly flags this as unresolved: 'logout is likely accessed via a different mechanism' (TBD/not yet located). Delete Account is likewise not present on the Distributor home grid — unclear whether it exists elsewhere in this role or is simply not offered to Distributors. The exact PENDING-return expiry window/duration is referenced ('before they expire') but never quantified. Distributor-specific Cancel Shipment behavior (present for Branch/Distributor per domain doc) is not explicitly re-documented in the distributor-my-shipments workflow beyond generic 'context-dependent actions' wording.
